title: Sharing an offline listening reflection
statements: Importing history and answering questions can happen entirely on this device.
Nothing is sent automatically. Review the exact export before choosing encrypted sharing.
You may separately choose whether to share normalized listening history. Responses-only sharing does not include it.
Your listening history and free-text answers may be sensitive. This study does not diagnose psychological conditions.

After transfer, deleting local data does not delete researcher-held copies. Contact the study researcher for withdrawal; backup retention and already disseminated anonymous results may limit deletion.
